newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Tuesday amid squaring of positions on settlement day, dealers said.
They said Monday's rise was likely to trigger some profit-taking, but overall the market was short and the index might rise on short-covering.

On Monday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 10.19 points, or 0.66 percent, to end at 1,553.65. Losers led gainers 162 to 94. Turnover fell to 48 million shares from 49 million in the previous session. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
